'''April 2001 Melbourne tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia on 8 April 2001. [[Adam Amy]] won it. It is known from Luca Costanzo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2063">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-melbourne-australia-8-4-2001d2063/ melbourne-australia-8-4-2001], DeckTech (Luca "Luca/Tzizvvt" Costanzo, 13 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-melbourne-australia-8-4-2001d2063/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Australia on Collins, Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Amy]]
